test_downstream_cache_hit_skips_upstream: test that a downstream cache hit never triggers upstream step _run execution
test_cache_key_deterministic: test that same step config and input uid produce the same cache key across runs
test_cache_shared_across_chain_lengths: test that steps with identical upstream prefix share cache across chains of different lengths
test_force_recomputes_and_propagates: test that force mode clears cache and recomputes downstream steps whose inputs changed
test_exec_params_are_model_config_not_ru: test that execution parameters live on the model config not as run method arguments
